newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn to redeem US$82.5 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn to redeem US$82.5 mln of notes.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp on Tuesday said it has issued notice that it will redeem US$82.5 million of the 10.875 percent senior notes issued by its Trizec Finance Ltd unit.
The Toronto-based real estate company said the delivery of the redemption notice to the trustee of the notes is consistent with the intention state in its recent equity prospectus.
TrizecHahn said it will redeem US$82.5 million of the principal amount of the notes outstanding at a price of US$109, plus accrued interest on June 30, 1997.
The company said the redemption will save about US$9 million annually in interest expense. After the redemption, US$167.5 million of the principal amount of the notes will remain outstanding.
The redemption will be administered by trustee Mellon Bank, F.S.B., in accordance with the terms of the trust indenture, TrizecHahn said.

Shares of TrizecHahn traded unchanged at C$29.95 in midafternoon trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. More than 44,000 shares had changed hands. TrizecHahn is listed in Toronto, Montreal and New York.
